t: A comparison he made using a woman in front of him
a: اللَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ بِوَلَدِهَا
m: He asked them: do you think this woman would throw her child into the fire? They said no, not if she could prevent it. He said: Allah is more merciful to His servants than this woman is to her child.
